name: add_github_actions_node_matrix
description: Turn a single-version CI job into a node 18/20/22 matrix with fail-fast: false; broken leaves fail-fast at the default so one failure cancels the rest
prompts: test.yml runs the test job on a single node version. Turn it into a matrix build across node 18, 20, and 22: add a strategy.matrix.node-version list, feed ${{ matrix.node-version }} into the setup-node step (not a hardcoded number), and set strategy.fail-fast to FALSE so that one version failing does not cancel the other versions' jobs - you want to see the full compatibility picture on every run. Keep the checkout / npm ci / npm test steps and the triggers unchanged.

setup_files..github/workflows/test.yml:
name: test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test

test_setup_files.check_matrix.py:
import yaml

with open(".github/workflows/test.yml") as f:
    wf = yaml.safe_load(f)

job = wf["jobs"]["test"]
strategy = job.get("strategy")
assert strategy, "no strategy block - matrix build not configured"

matrix = strategy.get("matrix")
assert matrix, "no matrix"
versions = matrix.get("node-version")
assert isinstance(versions, list) and set(versions) >= {18, 20, 22}, (
    f"matrix must cover node 18, 20, 22, got {versions}")

assert strategy.get("fail-fast") is False, (
    "strategy.fail-fast must be false - with the default (true), one failing "
    "node version cancels the rest and you can't see the full compatibility picture")

# the setup-node step must consume the matrix value, not a hardcoded version
steps = job["steps"]
setup = next((s for s in steps if str(s.get("uses", "")).startswith("actions/setup-node")), None)
assert setup, "setup-node step lost"
nv = str((setup.get("with") or {}).get("node-version", ""))
assert "matrix.node-version" in nv, (
    f"setup-node must use ${{{{ matrix.node-version }}}}, got {nv!r}")

runs = [s.get("run", "") for s in steps]
assert any("npm ci" in r for r in runs) and any("npm test" in r for r in runs), "build steps lost"

print("PASS matrix checks")

reference_solution..github/workflows/test.yml:
name: test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node-version: [18, 20, 22]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
